dispatch: manual, same original thresholds, experimental larger graph set
timing: GPU-drained native batch, all requests arrive together, includes prefill; no HTTP/profiler
stability_rule: Descriptive throughput criterion per cell: both paired round aggregates >= +2%; >=5/6 paired seed/runs positive; worst pair >= -1%; exact output budgets, no corruption/preemption. Repeated seeds are not independent samples, no significance claim. TTFT and request-mean TPOT reported separately.
limits: not online capacity or per-token ITL
Fast/Mega not batch invariant; retain trajectory divergences
